abstract_evidence_excerpt: Microaeration has emerged as a promising strategy for enhancing anaerobic digestion (AD) of lignocellulosic biomass, although inconsistent results highlight the need for further study. This study tested three different aeration rates (1, 5 and 8 mLO 2 /gVS) on anaerobic co-digestion of wheat straw and cattle manure under thermophilic conditions (55 °C) in continuous-stirred tank reactors with working volume of 60 L.
